error[ZBX-E1014]: the virtual machine's disk is full
  cause  the disk is 64 GiB and 12 MiB of it is free
  fix    see what the images cost, and remove what you do not need:          zbx store du --by-image
         or make the disk bigger, and stop the machine so that it applies:   zbx vm config --disk 128G && zbx vm stop
  more   zbx explain E1014 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1014.html
